sources.entry: Gladys - Privacy-first home assistant. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Nodejs/Docker
Gladys | Home Assistant for smart living

summary.one_liner: Gladys Assistant is an open-source, privacy-first smart home assistant that runs locally, installed via Docker.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Gladys Assistant as a privacy-first, open-source smart home assistant. It provides a Docker command to start a local instance, with options for setting the server port, timezone, SQLite database path, and volume mounts for the Docker socket, device paths, and udev/dbus. It also mentions a Docker Compose installation option. Installation guidance for mini-PCs, NAS devices, and Raspberry Pi is delegated to an external official website. The README includes development setup links for macOS/Linux and Windows, plus a contributing guide that references an AGENTS.md file for AI-assisted development.
use_cases: run a local smart home hub
install on Raspberry Pi or NAS
contribute to an open-source home automation project
how_to_run: sudo docker run -d --log-driver json-file --log-opt max-size=10m --cgroupns=host --restart=always --privileged --network=host --name gladys -e NODE_ENV=production -e SERVER_PORT=80 -e TZ=Europe/Paris -e SQLITE_FILE_PATH=/var/lib/gladysassistant/gladys-production.db -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v /var/lib/gladysassistant:/var/lib/gladysassistant -v /dev:/dev -v /run/udev:/run/udev:ro -v /run/dbus:/run/dbus:ro gladysassistant/gladys:v5
notable: Privacy-first design: runs as a local instance on your own hardware
Single Docker command to start, with a Docker Compose alternative mentioned
Explicit support for AI-assisted contributions via an AGENTS.md file
Community-driven project with an all-contributors credit list
caveats: The docker run command uses --privileged and mounts the Docker socket and /dev, which grants broad host access
Detailed installation steps are on an external website and not in the README
The README does not list supported smart home devices or protocols
